notes: Today's picks now tells you how old each pick is. A pick made two weeks ago was shown exactly like one made last night, at a price from its own day — which made a stale suggestion look current. Every pick now says when it was picked ('picked 13 days ago'), and anything older than about a trading week drops below a 'Still open' divider, slightly dimmed, so the freshest decisions always sit on top. Nothing is hidden: the older picks remain fully usable, and the server still retires them on its own rules.
